deliberation: The exact factor-0.1 arithmetic is not the attack surface. The candidate now preserves adverse outcomes in prose, orders four terminal labels, retains the reserved Human Steward action, and honestly binds a reconstructed predecessor schedule, but an attacker can still manufacture the event that starts every deadline, substitute identities while appearing independent, create cyclic or phantom work dependencies, race the observation cutoff, and relabel destructive or authority-sensitive work as routine retirement or bounded hardening. I reproduced four transform mutations that the canonical validator accepts with no error: a false source repository, removal of milestone D, an unknown GHOST predecessor, and a CMDG-A/CMDG-B cycle. I also produced a schema-valid activation receipt with an automation actor posing as Human Steward evidence, mutually inconsistent candidate and nested bindings, invented merge and readback identities, and T0 more than a month before readback. Separately, the Council review contract has no proposal-author identity, reviewer kind, session identity, authentication evidence, or review-artifact binding, even though GI-STEWARD-0002 requires non-author Adversary and distinct-session non-author Referee findings. Distinct reviewer_id strings therefore do not defeat aliasing by one author or invocation. At runtime, no closed occurrence, cutoff-snapshot, WIP lease, actor-separation, or terminal-disposition contract prevents two agents from exceeding WIP limits, a late receipt from rewriting the primary window, or an original author from self-declaring an independent external exercise. The plan's words prohibit authority expansion, but its every-P2DT19H12M instruction to retire branches, workflows, trackers, and reports does not distinguish recoverable archival from deletion or protected-workflow mutation. These are concrete authority, identity, and race counterexamples, not residual implementation detail. They require revised governed bytes and fresh exact-candidate review; conditions appended after approval cannot safely make this head executable.

The activation contract lacks the protected repository and branch, candidate-to-merge ancestry, protected readback head, exact required-check and independent-review evidence, authenticated Human Steward trust root and approving decision, equality constraints among nested and top-level bindings, canonical T0 derivation, one-time consumption, and replay or conflicting-activation rejection.

GI-STEWARD-0002 requires a non-author agent Adversary, a different non-author agent Referee from a distinct session, one authenticated named Human Steward authorization, protected integration, and readback. The Council matter and review schema record neither proposal authors nor reviewer kind, session identity, authentication, or attestation digest; the compiler enforces only unique reviewer_id strings. One actor can therefore satisfy apparent office separation by choosing aliases, and the activation schema does not bind the resulting office review digests.

The plan says roles must not be inferred from automation identity, yet supplies no staffing or attestation contract for accountable roles, independent reviewers, Referees, or the external reproducer. The original author can self-label a new agent identity as a non-author reviewer or outside actor, so EXT-B and several workstream independence gates are vulnerable to identity substitution.

The half-open observation interval and ordered terminal offsets are prose plus four manifest labels. There is no durable event ordering, occurrence key uniqueness, atomic cutoff snapshot, receipt causal timestamp, endpoint rule, immutable primary result, or late-event classification. A receipt racing the cutoff can be included or excluded by processing order and later rewrite PENDING_AT_CUTOFF or FAILED_AT_CUTOFF without violating a machine contract.

The WIP limits have no atomic lease, canonical candidate key, status-transition state machine, or cross-agent compare-and-set rule. Two agents can each observe an available slot and start work, or park and reopen candidates around the count, while every individual record appears compliant.

The zero-routine-human target is compatible with the active staffing schedule only while classification is honest and reserved triggers fail closed. Here the same unbound agents can classify work as routine, bounded hardening, retirement, or an agent-only external exercise; no executable authority classifier prevents a control-plane, publication, external-commitment, credential, or protected-rule action from being hidden in those categories.

The instruction to retire duplicate trackers, stale branches, redundant workflows, and reports every P2DT19H12M is not limited to nondestructive archival. Without target identity, provenance-preservation proof, recovery path, required-workflow protection, and reserved-authorization detection, it can be read as permission for destructive disposal or protected-workflow mutation contrary to Constitution Articles VIII and X.

The candidate appropriately preserves mathematical blockers, bounded negative results, advisory PRVSR status, visual_is_evidence false, and publication, deployment, product, revenue, and certification nonclaims. Deadline expiry alone therefore does not inflate a mathematical claim, but the missing execution contracts permit fabricated or rewritten evidence to be presented under those otherwise sound labels.

An agent exercise may satisfy EXT-B only when independence from every authoring session is verifiable; it must remain an operational exercise rather than external adoption.

Unknown or mixed-scope work must not be relabelled to meet the zero-human metric; retirement without a separately reserved decision must be recoverable archival only and must never delete provenance, branches, required workflows, protected rules, credentials, or authority-bearing records.

Make source and transform correspondence bijective and ordered, including exact repository identity, unique complete phase, milestone, and cadence sets, phase-cumulative-to-milestone equality, and semantic agreement with the normative plan. residual_uncertainty: The original uncommitted 90-day prose cannot be reconstructed byte-for-byte; the frozen source schedule is reproducible and candidly scoped, but it proves only the declared schedule transform.

Future protected heads, cadence-anchor intersections, due occurrences, required checks, reviews, mergeability, merge identity, and activation readback are volatile facts and are not established by this pre-activation review.

Even with corrected contracts, completing independent mathematical, semantic, operator, visual, and external-use review within P9D is an execution hypothesis. A blocker, bounded negative result, or owned continuation remains the lawful output when evidence is insufficient.

The operational meaning of retirement, bounded hardening, external commitment, publication, and production use can cross reserved-authority boundaries depending on the exact artifact and action; those determinations must be made against the active authority schedule at execution time.
No plan contract can itself establish CM4, T3, certification, novelty, adoption, deployment, revenue, or commercial readiness; those remain separately governed evidence and authority questions.
